ncc-merp-index.l: Did the error reach the patient? (An error of omission does reach the patient.)
Did the error contribute to or result in patient death?
Was intervention to preclude harm or extra monitoring required? (if not harmed)
Did the error require an intervention necessary to sustain life? (if harmed)
Was the harm permanent? (if life-sustaining intervention was needed)
Was the harm temporary? (if no life-sustaining intervention was needed)
Did the error require initial or prolonged hospitalization? (if the harm was temporary)

ncci-ptp.l: Which code is column 1 of the PTP pair
PTP modifier indicator (0 never bypass, 1 may bypass, 9 not applicable)
